title: dont hide then reveal alerts
rule: Don’t hide-then-reveal alerts in the DOM — older AT can still perceive visually hidden messages that are not currently applicable.
pass_when: Inapplicable alerts are not left visually hidden in the DOM.
fail_when: Alerts stay in the DOM as visually hidden until “revealed.”
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Site-alert unused-remove (`display:none`) from the first-pass catalog as this row.
